description: List oracle anchors issued by a given entity within a block height range, optionally filtered by an external timestamp range. Returns issuer entity, data hash, external timestamp, source hash, expiry and anchor heights, and data tag for each.

end_height.description: Last block height in the range, inclusive.

start_height.description: First block height in the range, inclusive.

ts_max.description: Optional highest external timestamp to include.

ts_min.description: Optional lowest external timestamp to include.

name: novai_get_oracle_anchors_by_entity
title: NOVAI oracle anchors by issuer entity
